core.scope: Full npm run check on current runtime candidate.

Background sample count incomplete; only complete short/long baselines used.
Native click coordinate shifted before source focus; fixture retries stable target.
Linked SVG assertion incorrectly included 5.6px theme padding; content-box measurement fixed.
Capture also counted accidental graphic hits during leave-source clicks. Sampling is now armed only for intended source activation; final 60 samples all begin unfocused.

limits: 400-line native source expansion still costs about 223ms median; background tail latency remains higher.
Remote-desktop encoding/network, physical user-desktop GPU timing, full native theme matrix, prolonged pressure and other platforms were not measured.
